node.title: L1 bounded-mark affine split-pencil compiler
node.statement: For one source chart and fixed defect degree, deleting v dense-petal equations partitions the monic partial-petal pairs into at most q^v affine syndromes. Each fiber is a translate of the full-petal monicity-preserving kernel and homogenizes by exactly one projective direction. Every actual pair also gives arbitrary-locator identities L_Ti C_i=J(W-c_iF), deg C_i<=d-ell+v, gcd(JF,JW)=J. At fixed polarized entropy p<=P, support patterns and syndromes cost at most (P+1)n^(1/c_0+P+gamma P) per defect degree. The remaining cell theorem is a uniform split/saturated-point bound in these one-direction extensions, together with non-intrinsic first-match chart supply; zero-syndrome full-petal payment is not silently reused.
